notes: Reached via Claude-in-Chrome only (no curl/proxy). robots.txt (confirmed by prior Home-Decor pass, re-verified reachable) has no Claude-specific disallow. Category tree pulled from the site's own React SSR state: every listing page embeds a JSON script tag id='__PRELOADED_STATE__' (NOT a window global -- must be read via document.getElementById + JSON.parse) whose listingV2.filters[category_filter].values holds the full Home-department category tree with an explicit productCount per node, sourced from the main Home listing page https://www.nykaafashion.com/home/c/8528. This is the same mechanism the prior Home-Decor pass (archive c282) used and explicitly excluded 'Accent Furniture' (furniture) from its own scope -- this pass targets exactly that excluded branch plus a fresh walk of every other Home department for furniture-typed nodes the decor pass wouldn't have looked for. Full Home department = Decor, Kitchen & Dining, Bedding, Bath, Storage, Home Essentials, Appliances (7 top-level nodes, unchanged from prior pass). Walked every department's full child tree looking for furniture: Kitchen & Dining (incl. Bar Essentials -- bar tools/decanters/openers, no bar carts or stools), Bedding (bedsheets/cushions/quilts/mattress -- textile only, no bed frames), Bath (incl. Bath Accessories & Utilities -- soap dishes/caddies/holders, no bathroom furniture), Storage (Organizers/Jars & Containers/Lunch Essentials/Bins/Quick Fold Cabinets -- the last verified by title-check to be plastic collapsible closet/storage boxes, standalone storage goods not furniture), Home Essentials (incl. Daily Hacks > Ladders & Stools, title-checked to be foldable step ladders/utility tools, not seating furniture; Tools & Hardware > Ironing Boards, a utility item not furniture), Appliances (Kitchen/Home Appliances, Garment Care -- no furniture). The ONLY furniture-bearing branch found is Decor > Accent Furniture (13 leaf children, flat one level deep, no further nesting). Also checked Decor > Pooja Essentials > Pooja Chowki (5 items) -- a small wooden ritual-idol stand, not human-use furniture and not filed under the site's furniture department, excluded. QTY METHOD: for every included/excluded-for-verification leaf, navigated directly to the category's own listing page (URL resolves purely by its trailing /c/<id> segment, confirmed by prior pass and re-confirmed here) and read listingV2.count + listingV2.categoryURL (the page's own live per-category count and canonical URL) as an independent second signal against the category_filter tree's productCount. All checked leaves matched exactly (Ottoman & Benches 519=519, Accent Stool 510=510, Coffee & Center Tables 410=410, Side Table & Nesting Table 405=405, Accent Chair 325=325, Wine Rack 38=38, Writing Desk 23=23, Lap Table 13=13, Serving Trolley 4=4, TV Units 3=3, Swivel Chair 3=3, Chair Pads 26=26) -- dual-signal agreement satisfies the exhaustion check, consistent with the prior pass's finding that this facet count is a direct database count, not a rounded/capped widget. EXCLUDED from Accent Furniture: 'Sofa & Chair Covers' (1623 products) -- furniture care/protective covers, explicitly out of scope per brief; 'Chair Pads' (26) -- title-checked to be fabric seat cushions/pads and office-chair covers, textile not furniture. FLAGGED: 'Wine Rack' (38) -- title-checked; the category mixes small tabletop/countertop bottle holders and racks (the majority) with a few genuine small bar-furniture pieces (e.g. 'Model J Mini Home Bar' foldable bar table). Kept as a furniture row per the site's own Accent Furniture classification but flagged for manual review since most individual products read closer to a tabletop storage/decor accessory than furniture proper. No Kids-specific home furniture department exists separately from the 7 Home departments walked. No search-absence claims were needed since Accent Furniture is a real, populated, directly-browsable node.
